decisions.reason: This specialized spraying system still builds directly on our coating and two-component application know-how, and our in-house R&D and research links give us sufficient capacity to learn from use cases and improve it rather than withdraw it.
The low-pressure injection pump remains very close to our existing pumping and injection capabilities, so it can be supported, adapted, and sold with little organizational stretch.
As a multi-model transfer pump line rooted in our core material-conveying knowledge and broad product architecture, it fits strongly with what we already know and can refine commercially.

Although newer to the market, the hydraulic two-component spraying system is closely related to our established spraying platform, giving us a strong basis to absorb feedback and develop it further instead of exiting quickly.
